rule.verdict: five or more divergences never decides alone: fail on divergences above 0.5% of the kept draws, on split R-hat above 1.01 or bulk effective sample size below 400 of the D50 or D99 crossing draws (a bound level exempt; a thinned export's sample size reported, not gated); the engine's count flag beside as a note
rule.concentration: a reading beside the gates, never a hold
